provenance: Every document is a byte-exact copy of a file that its publisher serves publicly from raw.githubusercontent.com, in the repositories and branches named under "sources" (research and board publications of the Sift data pipeline, plus the live-quote feed branch of this repository). They are kept here only so that the SIFT 3.0 test suite can reproduce real-document behaviour offline on a fixed clock; no document is modified (the only test-time transformations are the documented re-stamps in e2e/support). Prices and probabilities inside them describe the instants named in this manifest and are neither current nor a recommendation. Use of the data stays subject to the publishers' own terms and the terms of the third-party sources they cite; inclusion here implies no endorsement by, or affiliation with, any league, team, player, data provider or exchange named in them.
